Indian Media Outlets Archive Pages

Multiple Indian media outlets, including The Print and Telangana Today, have published pages designated as archives for various sections. These archives cover topics such as 'YourTurn', 'ancient science', 'Sport', '50-Word Edit', and general 'Features' and 'Opinion' sections. The pages appear to be navigational or index pages for older content, with specific page numbers indicated for some archives.
